frequency_question: What proportion of scheduled policy rate decisions that result in substantive tightening actions successfully meet the formal criteria of an official announcement without procedural or technical misfires before the deadline?
membership_rule: Includes all formal rate-setting meetings where a central bank committee deliberates and issues resolutions on benchmark rates; excludes unscheduled emergency interventions and administrative typos corrected within the same business day.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named recent instances; universal adherence to formal announcement standards upon decision.
known_gaps: Minor variations in exact publication hour due to website updates, but never missing the calendar day or formal criteria.
skeleton: Sequential scheduled bi-monthly monetary policy committee announcement cycles over a multi-year baseline.
multiplier: 6 historical instances examined; 6 formal announcements successfully meeting criteria without technical failure.
validity_reason: Central bank communication protocols and legal announcement frameworks remain stable across multi-year horizons.
